title: prangos angustifolia
intro: Prangos angustifolia, commonly known as Ferula angustifolia, is a plant species belonging to the family Apiaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Eastern Europe and Western Asia, due to its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Prangos angustifolia include pain relief, wound healing, and respiratory health improvement. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
